baseline: Cite concrete defects and retain uncertainty; no tool-certified semantic claims.
candidate: Report a defect only when the supplied source or an explicit acceptance requirement supports it. Label missing evidence as unknown. Keep optional precision suggestions separate from blocking defects. Do not infer a new requirement from wording you would prefer.
